pages.text: Park within 10 blocks of an $(item)Insurance Office$() and buy cover: a term of 7 Minecraft days. Then when crash damage (the body, the glass, the lamps) is repaired at a Repair Bench, the insurer pays back what it cost over the deductible, up to the claim limit.$(br2)Wear isn't covered. The office's owner sets the prices and pays the claims.
